n: Kaplan Cooper STEM Robot classroom set
t: A set of four screen-free coding robots with cards and lesson plans.
steps: Order Kaplan item 302761 from Kaplan Early Learning.
Charge the four robots with the included USB-to-USB-C cable.
Choose a first lesson from the 20 lesson plans.
Keep the robots away from children under 3.
Run a first group challenge with the ball.
